integrity: A standalone Python standard-library verifier reconstructs the graph, checks an explicit isomorphism, independently enumerates both states and moves, cross-checks components, and exhaustively computes distances. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the twenty-vertex Desargues graph only. No result is asserted for arbitrary generalized Petersen or bipartite Kneser graphs; most component and distance conclusions are exhaustive computations, not symbolic family theorems. Possible unindexed equivalent computations remain an originality risk.
title: Token-sliding occupancy spectrum of the Desargues graph
